description: Collect public Snapchat Spotlight videos from topic pages, hashtag feeds and the anonymous Spotlight feed, with creator, engagement, AI keywords, hashtags and S2I content tags. Discover related topics from keyword search.

enrichVideos.description: Visit each video's Spotlight page to fill missing AI title, comment/recommend counts, language, S2I tags and sound, and each creator's profile once for subscriberCount. Cached and bounded; failures keep the original row.
enrichVideos.title: Enrich videos with detail pages

includeRelatedTags.description: Include Snapchat's scene-to-interest (S2I) tags for each video when the page provides them. Coverage is partial, so the field is omitted when unavailable.
includeRelatedTags.title: Include S2I content tags

includeRelatedTopics.description: Add one hop of related topics found on each discovered topic's topic, tag, or Explore page. This follows public page links; it does not recurse further.
includeRelatedTopics.title: Expand related topics

maxItems.description: Maximum rows to save across the whole run.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxResultsPerTopic.description: Maximum videos to keep for each topic after combining its topic/tag page with Explore results. Snapchat serves 19-32 videos per page and the combined pool is usually 40-54.
maxResultsPerTopic.title: Max videos per topic

maxTopicsPerQuery.description: Maximum topic rows to keep for each search query, including related topics when expansion is enabled.
maxTopicsPerQuery.title: Max topics per query

mode.description: Choose what to collect: videos for topics/tags, topics for search keywords, or the current Spotlight feed.
mode.title: Mode

searchQueries.description: Keywords or phrases used to discover topics, such as coffee, new york, or taylor swift.
searchQueries.sectionDescription: Used in Find topics by keyword mode.
searchQueries.title: Search keywords

topics.description: Topic names, hashtags, or Snapchat URLs. Examples: food, #travel, https://www.snapchat.com/tag/food, https://www.snapchat.com/topic/cappuccino-foam-technique.
topics.sectionDescription: Used in Topic or tag videos mode. Each topic is checked on its topic and tag pages, then combined with Explore Spotlight results.
topics.title: Topics or tags

title: Snapchat Topic Scraper
